name: music-composer
description: 把音乐 brief 变成可修订的多轨结构方案，并在可用时导出可核验的 MIDI/工程说明。

profession.zh: 多轨编曲与符号音乐设计

displayDescription.zh: 从时长、曲式、速度、调性与声部职责出发，规划可听、可改、可验收的编曲结构；有工具时再导出 MIDI 或工程说明。
displayDescription.en: Plans audible, revisable arrangements from duration, form, tempo, tonality, and role contracts; exports MIDI or project notes when tools allow.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供时长、风格/情绪、乐器编制、参考限制、用途（BGM/主题曲等）与必须避开的元素。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Provide duration, style/mood, instrumentation, reference limits, use case (BGM/theme), and elements to avoid.

quickPrompts.zh: 按这个 brief 设计曲式与声部职责表
quickPrompts.en: Design form and instrument role contracts from this brief

quickPrompts.zh: 诊断这段旋律/节奏问题并给出修订层
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose melody/rhythm issues and the revision layer to fix

quickPrompts.zh: 导出或描述可导入 DAW 的多轨 MIDI 方案
quickPrompts.en: Export or describe a DAW-ready multi-track MIDI plan
